# FinancialQ Group

FinancialQ Group is a U.S. SEC-registered investment advisor (Form ADV firm #327095) that provides institutional-grade wealth management under a fiduciary standard. Its platform is built on mandate-driven portfolios, explicit risk budgeting and regime-aware allocation, serving high-income professionals, cross-border entrepreneurs, international investors and founders after a liquidity event.

The site is bilingual: every page exists at an English URL and a Spanish URL with equivalent content.

## Core pages (English)

- [Home](https://financialqgroup.com/): Structured capital management built for permanence — firm overview, client segments, methodological framework and latest perspectives.
- [About the firm](https://financialqgroup.com/about): Who FinancialQ Group is, how it is structured and what the fiduciary registration means in practice.
- [Mission and vision](https://financialqgroup.com/about/mission): The firm's purpose and long-term commitments to clients.
- [Fiduciary governance](https://financialqgroup.com/about/governance): Conflict-of-interest policy, fee-only model and the controls behind every recommendation.
- [Our approach](https://financialqgroup.com/approach): Investment philosophy — how portfolios are designed by mandate rather than by product.
- [Methodological framework](https://financialqgroup.com/approach/framework): The pillars that structure portfolio construction.
- [Investment process](https://financialqgroup.com/approach/process): Step-by-step method from mandate definition to ongoing supervision.
- [Risk philosophy](https://financialqgroup.com/approach/risk): Explicit risk budgeting and how risk is measured, allocated and monitored.
- [Clients](https://financialqgroup.com/clients): The four client profiles the firm serves and what each mandate looks like.
- [Perspectives](https://financialqgroup.com/perspectives): Market commentary and research notes on liquidity, credit spreads, asset allocation and risk.
- [Contact](https://financialqgroup.com/contact): Inquiry form, office details and consultation scheduling.

## Firm details

- Legal / regulatory: U.S. SEC-registered investment advisor. Public record: [Form ADV — firm #327095](https://adviserinfo.sec.gov/firm/summary/327095)
- Compensation model: fee-only fiduciary
- Main office: 14 Wall Street, 20th Floor, New York, NY 10005, USA
- Phone: +1 407-288-0087 (Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm EST)
- Email: admin@financialqgroup.com
